preview.text: South Africa Champions play England Champions at Sharjah Cricket Stadium. Sides batting first here usually make about 153 (82 recorded T20 matches). South Africa Champions won the toss and chose to bat first. The forecast for the next 8 hours gives up to a 0 per cent chance of rain, at about 33 degrees.

summary.text: South Africa Champions won by 9 runs. SACH made 204-5, Jean-Paul Duminy top-scoring with 76 off 43 balls; Liam Plunkett took 3 for 35. ENGCH made 186-6, Dawid Malan top-scoring with 88 off 51 balls; Wayne Parnell took 2 for 29. Sides batting first at Sharjah Cricket Stadium usually make about 153.
